scope: Five pre-construction concepts, not built participant tasks. None selected for pilot construction.

candidates.title: Rescue an energy-resolved eigenstate analysis pipeline
candidates.archetype: A: workspace diagnosis, repair, and performance validation
candidates.central_contribution: Realization-specific spectral targeting and agreement of level statistics, entanglement, fluctuations, and participation measures across ergodic and localized regimes.
candidates.artifact: The same-author sinvert_mbl solver plus a benchmark-authored observable/ensemble workspace. No original broken analysis workspace was found.

consequential_decisions.evidence: residual, coverage, fill, runtime and memory measurements

candidates.feedback_loop: Reproduce a disagreement among probes, inspect target/residual/ensemble diagnostics, repair the implicated stages, rerun and compare.
candidates.public_evidence: Hamiltonian definitions, small exact checks, unlabeled physical instances, partial diagnostics; no main-dataset expected outputs.
candidates.multiobjective_evaluator: Observable correctness and eigenpair certification, worst-family behavior, runtime/memory, and consistency of aggregate evidence.
candidates.likely_shortcut: Generic sparse shift-invert plus standard tensor reductions and cluster aggregation. The same solver and observable code handles all proposed physical families.
candidates.irreducibility_assessment: Fails. Target conventions, tensor embedding, and independent statistical units become conventional fixes once the specification is complete; layering these fixes into multiple files does not make them frontier-hard.
candidates.evidence: private/shortcut_probe_results/summary.json tests the numerical shortcut, not an entire task or frontier agent.

candidates.title: Reconcile inconsistent finite-size mobility-edge estimates
candidates.archetype: D: experiment design and evidence reconciliation
candidates.central_contribution: Energy-dependent transition estimates from multiple finite-size collapses, including sensitivity of critical disorder and exponent to analysis windows.
candidates.artifact: Original figure PDFs and fitting discussion are available; original sample-level tables and covariances were not found in the inspected artifacts.

consequential_decisions.evidence: residual patterns and held-out system sizes

alternatives: local fit windows with size exclusions

candidates.feedback_loop: Fit competing explanations, inspect residuals and size/window sensitivity, revise the selected model or sampling plan, and rerun held-out validation.
candidates.public_evidence: A self-contained task would require raw physical ensembles and an auditable acquisition manifest, not only figure digitization.
proposed_hidden_families: paired energy targets with shared disorder
candidates.multiobjective_evaluator: Held-out fit quality, interval calibration, worst-regime stability, and evidence consistency.
candidates.likely_shortcut: Bounded nonlinear least squares or variable projection, standard cluster resampling, and a fit-window sweep implement the supplied paper procedure.
candidates.irreducibility_assessment: Fails. Fitting a synthetic collapse generator would replace the paper's central workflow with an easier inverse problem. Real finite-size data do not supply a uniquely identifiable thermodynamic target; grading one reference's extrapolation as truth would be scientifically invalid.

candidates.title: Recover large-system interior spectra under a memory budget
candidates.archetype: A/E: performance repair and distributed integration
candidates.central_contribution: Massively parallel spectral transformation enabling energy-resolved eigenstate measurements beyond dense diagonalization sizes.
candidates.artifact: Actual MPI/PETSc/SLEPc demonstration, basis ownership, nonzero assembly, CMake files, and solver integration are available.

consequential_decisions.evidence: symbolic fill and measured factorization cost

candidates.feedback_loop: Profile a failed or inefficient run, adjust the numerical/parallel strategy, rerun at multiple sizes, and verify residuals and observables.
candidates.public_evidence: Would require a validated deployed solver stack, real profiles, and reproducible hardware/resource limits; the source alone does not supply this benchmark.
candidates.multiobjective_evaluator: Certified spectrum coverage, peak memory, throughput, and worst-case stability.
candidates.likely_shortcut: At bounded sizes, call the existing sparse direct/Krylov stack. At production scale, standard distributed-factorization configuration is a credible approach and would need an actual performance pilot to distinguish from novel engineering.
candidates.irreducibility_assessment: Not established. Small cases lose the original engineering difficulty; merely imposing a limit below a large factorization's runtime is not acceptable hardness. No real pre-fix performance regression or heterogeneous failure corpus was found. The small numerical probe does not settle production-scale difficulty, and is not represented as doing so.

candidates.title: Audit real-space localization versus Hilbert-space delocalization
candidates.archetype: B/D: reproduction, ablation, and evidence reconciliation
candidates.central_contribution: Area-law entanglement can coexist with growing participation entropy; the paper does not identify a unique slow-growth asymptote in its finite size range.
candidates.artifact: Original entanglement and participation figures and equations, plus the later solver's wavefunction export facility; no raw archived wavefunctions were found.
candidates.feedback_loop: Measure competing diagnostics, ablate numerical cutoffs and size windows, rerun, and qualify the conclusion using the observed uncertainty.
candidates.public_evidence: Physical wavefunctions and invariant checks could be generated, but would be new simulations rather than the original measurements.
candidates.multiobjective_evaluator: Entropy accuracy, stability to probability tails, resource scaling, and calibrated model-comparison claims.
candidates.likely_shortcut: SVD/eigenspectrum reductions and stable probability sums, followed by conventional regression and a statement of finite-size ambiguity.
candidates.irreducibility_assessment: Fails. The numerical work is direct observable implementation; distinguishing asymptotes beyond the available finite-size information cannot fairly be made an exact hidden target. Invented labeled wavefunction ensembles would be a different, synthetic inference task.

candidates.title: Recover an unbiased ensemble from restarted spectral jobs
candidates.archetype: A/E: data integrity, recovery, and pipeline repair
candidates.central_contribution: Trustworthy energy packets and disorder-level aggregation are necessary for energy-resolved level statistics and a mobility-edge analysis.
candidates.artifact: The source supports eigenpair extraction, but no original restart archive, corrupted export, manifest, or biased acquisition dataset is available. A workspace would be benchmark-authored.

consequential_decisions.evidence: residuals, target coverage and job provenance

candidates.feedback_loop: Audit the archive, choose recovery actions, rerun suspect jobs, reaggregate, and check whether the scientific discrepancy survives.
candidates.public_evidence: Would need manifests, partial packets, numerical invariants, and recoverable Hamiltonians; these do not exist in the inspected release.
candidates.family_gate_warning: Several entries are acquisition or representation changes rather than independent physical families; they must not be counted automatically as five legitimate hidden families.
candidates.multiobjective_evaluator: Unbiased observable recovery, gap coverage, acquisition cost, and consistency of tables and scientific claims.
candidates.likely_shortcut: Ignore unreliable cached packets and rerun a conventional solver from the supplied Hamiltonians, then aggregate by realization. Banning this otherwise valid method would make the evaluator method-dependent.
candidates.irreducibility_assessment: Fails. Small bounded recovery is ordinary solver/ETL repair. Making reruns prohibitively expensive solely to force archive forensics would manufacture difficulty instead of recovering a documented source workflow.
